summary: Russia conducted a massive, multi-axis Shahed and Geran-5 drone/missile barrage lasting over 23 hours, targeting at least 10 Ukrainian oblasts with confirmed Geran-5 strikes on Rivne, Kyiv/Boryspil, and Kamianets-Podilskyi. Ukraine struck three Russian refineries, including Lukoil-Nizhegorodnefteorgsintez in Kstovo, after the energy truce ended. Zelensky proposed a three-way meeting with Putin and Trump in Istanbul to discuss war termination.
key_points: Russian Shahed/Geran-5 attack ongoing >23 hours with launches from Kursk continuing >28 hours. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77704; @mon1tor_ua/77733)
Geran-5 missiles struck Rivne city, targeted Kyiv/Boryspil area, and hit Kamianets-Podilskyi. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77728; @mon1tor_ua/77724; @mon1tor_ua/77706)
Ukrainian drones attacked Lukoil-Nizhegorodnefteorgsintez refinery in Kstovo, Nizhny Novgorod region. (Source: @UkraineNow/85042)
Ukraine struck three Russian refineries accounting for ~10% refining capacity after energy truce ended. (Source: @UkraineNow/85054)
Russian drone attack on Koziatyn, Vinnytsia region killed 2 civilians and injured 3 children. (Source: @UkraineNow/85051)
Russian drone attack on Chernivtsi injured a 67-year-old man. (Source: @UkraineNow/85049)
DeepStateMap reports Russian forces advanced near Hoptivka. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23957)
Russian Tu-95MS bombers expected to relocate from Ukrainka to Olenya airfield, signaling possible massive missile strike in 2-4 days. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77735)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a massive, multi-axis Shahed and Geran-5 barrage lasting over 23 hours, with launches from Kursk continuing beyond 28 hours, targeting at least 10 Ukrainian oblasts including Kyiv, Rivne, Vinnytsia, and Kharkiv. Confirmed Geran-5 strikes hit Rivne, the Kyiv/Boryspil area, and Kamianets-Podilskyi, while reactive UAVs from the Black Sea targeted Odesa, Mykolaiv, and Tatarbunary. Ukraine responded with strikes on three Russian refineries — including Lukoil in Kstovo — and Zelensky proposed a three-way summit with Putin and Trump in Istanbul.

points: Ukrainian drones attacked the Lukoil-Nizhegorodnefteorgsintez refinery in Kstovo, Nizhny Novgorod region, and struck two additional Russian refineries after the energy truce ended, targeting ~10% of Russian refining capacity. (Source: @UkraineNow/85042; @UkraineNow/85054)
Zelensky stated readiness to meet Putin and Trump in Istanbul, citing Erdogan's communication channels with Putin, to discuss war termination conditions. (Source: @UkraineNow/85057)

Zelensky claimed October record Russian losses: 54,400 killed and heavily wounded, with a single-day peak of 2,250 on 21 October, and Ukrainian forces regained 96.2 sq km — 10.4 sq km more than Russia captured. (Source: @UkraineNow/85048)

The 'Air Alert' mobile application was reportedly hacked by Russian actors, but Kyiv Digital app and street siren systems in Kyiv operated normally; chemical threat and street fighting alerts in Kyiv were lifted at 23:53 on 01.11.2026. (Source: @kpszsu/92165; @mon1tor_ua/77738; @eRadarrua/127946; @eRadarrua/127949; @eRadarrua/127950)
Between 11 and 17 buses evacuated residents from Oleshky (Kherson region) to Ukrainian-controlled territory, while only three half-empty buses went to Russia. (Source: @UkraineNow/85045)

Russia conducted a massive Shahed/Geran-5 barrage for over 23 hours, launching from Kursk (continuing >28 hours), Crimea, Black Sea, and occupied territories, targeting Kyiv, Rivne, Vinnytsia, Khmelnytskyi, Cherkasy, Poltava, Kirovohrad, Mykolaiv, Odesa, Kharkiv, Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, and Sumy oblasts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77704; @mon1tor_ua/77733; @mon1tor_ua/77727; @mon1tor_ua/77734; @mon1tor_ua/77741; @mon1tor_ua/77725; @mon1tor_ua/77736; @mon1tor_ua/77729)

Geran-5 missiles struck Rivne city, targeted the Kyiv/Boryspil area (two missiles), and hit Kamianets-Podilskyi; a reactive Shahed hit near Voznesensk, Mykolaiv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77728; @mon1tor_ua/77724; @mon1tor_ua/77706; @mon1tor_ua/77727)

Reactive UAVs launched from Black Sea waters targeted Odesa, Tatarbunary, Mykolaiv, and the Odesa-Mykolaiv administrative border; two reactive UAVs from Crimea tracked toward Pivdenne. (Source: @kpszsu/92170; @kpszsu/92168; @kpszsu/92202; @kpszsu/92184; @kpszsu/92192; @eRadarrua/127939)
Russian Tu-95MS bombers expected to relocate from Ukrainka airfield to Olenya airfield, with a massive combined missile strike anticipated in 2-4 days. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77735)

Russian drone attack on Koziatyn community, Vinnytsia region, killed a man and a woman and hospitalized three children (two 5-year-olds and a 16-year-old); strike hit between a dormitory and an educational facility. (Source: @UkraineNow/85051)
Russian drone attack on Chernivtsi damaged an administrative civilian building and injured a 67-year-old man. (Source: @UkraineNow/85049)
A homemade gyrocopter crashed in Kayurovo village, Tver region, killing the Russian pilot. (Source: @eRadarrua/127925)
DeepStateMap reports Russian forces advanced near Hoptivka (Kharkiv oblast). (Source: @DeepStateUA/23957)

Reactive UAVs observed in Dnipropetrovsk oblast near Shakhtarske, Slavhorod, Yurivka, and moving westward toward the Zaporizhzhia border; one UAV over Dnipro city from the east. (Source: @eRadarrua/127945; @kpszsu/92169; @kpszsu/92175; @mon1tor_ua/77725)

Kharkiv oblast: reactive UAVs near Savyntsi, Chuhuiv (non-return), and Lozova; launches from Kharkiv oblast toward Poltava. (Source: @eRadarrua/127945; @eRadarrua/127941; @kpszsu/92191; @mon1tor_ua/77725; @mon1tor_ua/77727)

Three UAVs from Dnipropetrovsk targeted Kirovohrad oblast (Oleksandriia district); two reactive UAVs from Dnipropetrovsk to Kirovohrad (Oleksandriia district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77727; @mon1tor_ua/77736)
Strike UAVs passed Slavhorod, Dnipropetrovsk, heading west. (Source: @kpszsu/92175)
Shahed launches from Kursk oblast continued for over 28 hours. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77733)

Reactive UAVs from Sumy oblast targeted Poltava (Lubny, Myrhorod, Poltava districts) and Chernihiv (Pryluky district); Geran-5 from Sumy to Poltava (Lubny district) and Chernihiv (Pryluky district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77727; @mon1tor_ua/77725; @mon1tor_ua/77736; @mon1tor_ua/77729)
Reactive UAVs from Chernihiv oblast (north) targeted Nizhyn; Geran-5 from Zhytomyr to Rivne (Rivne district). (Source: @kpszsu/92198; @mon1tor_ua/77727; @mon1tor_ua/77736)

Reactive UAVs from Poltava oblast targeted Cherkasy (Zolotonosha district) and Kyiv (Boryspil district); Geran-5 from Poltava to Kyiv (Boryspil district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77725; @mon1tor_ua/77736; @mon1tor_ua/77729)
Non-reactive UAVs from Putyvl, Sumy oblast, moving westward past Konotop. (Source: @kpszsu/92167; @eRadarrua/127947)

Reactive UAVs from Black Sea waters targeted Odesa, Tatarbunary, Mykolaiv (Bashtanka district), and the Odesa-Mykolaiv border; one UAV on the Mykolaiv-Odesa border heading north. (Source: @kpszsu/92170; @kpszsu/92168; @kpszsu/92202; @kpszsu/92184; @kpszsu/92192; @mon1tor_ua/77741)
Two reactive UAVs from Crimea with prior course toward Pivdenne (Mykolaiv oblast). (Source: @eRadarrua/127939)
Reactive UAV from Kirovohrad oblast targeted Dolynska; reactive UAV from Kirovohrad to Cherkasy (Cherkasy district). (Source: @kpszsu/92164; @eRadarrua/127921; @mon1tor_ua/77736)
Reactive UAV from Mykolaiv/Odesa border area targeted Vinnytsia (Haisyn district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77725)

Reactive UAV from Vinnytsia oblast targeted Khmelnytskyi (Shepetivka and Kamianets-Podilskyi districts); three UAVs from Vinnytsia to Khmelnytskyi (Shepetivka district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77727; @mon1tor_ua/77736; @mon1tor_ua/77741)

Massive Shahed/Geran-5 wave: >23 hours continuous, with 12 Shaheds on Kyiv-Cherkasy border toward Vinnytsia, 3 on Vinnytsia-Zhytomyr border toward Khmelnytskyi, 8 from Sumy to Poltava (Myrhorod), 7 from Dnipropetrovsk to Poltava, 3 near Cherkasy toward Vinnytsia, 3 from Poltava to Cherkasy (Zolotonosha), 2 from Vinnytsia to Khmelnytskyi (Shepetivka), 11 from Poltava to Cherkasy (Zolotonosha), 6 from Sumy to Poltava (Lubny), 3 from Cherkasy to Kyiv (Obukhiv), 4 from Kyiv to Vinnytsia, 3 from Khmelnytskyi to Rivne. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77727; @mon1tor_ua/77734; @mon1tor_ua/77741; @mon1tor_ua/77725; @mon1tor_ua/77736; @mon1tor_ua/77729)

Geran-5 missiles: 1 from Zhytomyr to Rivne (Sarnenskyi), 1 from Cherkasy to Kyiv (Obukhiv), 1 from Sumy to Poltava (Lubny), 1 from Poltava to Kyiv (Boryspil), 1 from Sumy to Chernihiv (Pryluky), 1 from Zhytomyr to Rivne (Rivne district), 2 on Kyiv/Boryspil. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77727; @mon1tor_ua/77725; @mon1tor_ua/77736; @mon1tor_ua/77724; @mon1tor_ua/77729)

Reactive Shaheds: 1 from Cherkasy to Vinnytsia, 1 from Dnipropetrovsk to Kirovohrad (Oleksandriia), 1 from Kharkiv to Poltava, 1 from Black Sea to Mykolaiv/Odesa border, 3 from Dnipropetrovsk to Kirovohrad (Kropyvnytskyi), 2 from Vinnytsia to Khmelnytskyi (Kamianets-Podilskyi), 1 on Nizhyn (Chernihiv), 1 from Cherkasy to Kyiv (Obukhiv), 1 from Poltava to Cherkasy (Zolotonosha), 1 from Kharkiv to Poltava, 1 from Dnipropetrovsk to Mykolaiv (Bashtanka), 1 from Dnipropetrovsk to Kirovohrad (Oleksandriia), 1 on Dnipro from east, 1 near Ustynivka (Kirovohrad), 1 on Dolynska (Kirovohrad), 1 on Savyntsi (Kharkiv), 1 on Shakhtarske (Dnipropetrovsk). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77727; @mon1tor_ua/77741; @mon1tor_ua/77725; @mon1tor_ua/77736; @mon1tor_ua/77729; @eRadarrua/127941; @eRadarrua/127921; @kpszsu/92164; @eRadarrua/127945)

Air Alert app hacked; Kyiv Digital and street sirens functional; chemical threat and street fighting alerts lifted in Kyiv. (Source: @kpszsu/92165; @mon1tor_ua/77738; @eRadarrua/127946; @eRadarrua/127949; @eRadarrua/127950)
eRadar official Shahed map hacked after online Shahed tracking began. (Source: @eRadarrua/127940)

key_developments: Russia's 23+ hour Shahed/Geran-5 barrage from Kursk, Crimea, Black Sea, and occupied territories targeted 10+ Ukrainian oblasts with dozens of UAVs and multiple Geran-5 missiles. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77704; @mon1tor_ua/77733; @mon1tor_ua/77727)

Confirmed Geran-5 strikes on Rivne city, Kyiv/Boryspil area (two missiles), and Kamianets-Podilskyi; reactive Shahed hit near Voznesensk, Mykolaiv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77728; @mon1tor_ua/77724; @mon1tor_ua/77706; @mon1tor_ua/77727)
